subject: Gainsight renewal: billing model & usage credits
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@gainsight.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Gainsight renewal: billing model & usage credits

Hi Alyssa —

As we approach the Oct 15 renewal for our CS platform, we want to propose a change to the billing model for the renewal/amendment. Our usage pattern for in-product guides and playbooks has become more spiky (seasonal releases and pilot programs). Instead of simply renewing on a seat-only basis, can Gainsight propose a blended seat + usage credit model (baseline seats + a pool of usage credits that burn against short-term pilots)?

What we need from you to move this internally:
- A short (1–2 page) amendment / SOW that shows blended pricing with a clear line item for usage credits (monthly and annual burn scenarios).
- An estimate of pilot credits you can include as a one-time concession for the first quarter.
- Confirmation of SOC 2 availability and any data retention/deletion clauses we should be aware of.

I've attached our current SOW for reference. Timing: procurement needs a signed amendment and PO by Friday, Oct 8 to avoid any disruption. Can you turn a draft by next Wednesday (Sep 21)?

Thanks — we want to keep the rollout simple, avoid a full reprocurement, but need the economics to reflect our new usage shape.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
[attachment: Redwood_Gainsight_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@gainsight.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Gainsight CSM <csm@gainsight.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Gainsight renewal: billing model & usage credits

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely propose a blended model: baseline seat commitment + consumable usage credits for guides/playbooks and pilot programs. I've attached a preliminary amendment/quote (Gainsight_Amendment_Q3_v1.pdf) that outlines two options:

Option A — Conservative: 10% usage credits included, lower per-credit rate;
Option B — Aggressive: 25% usage credits included, mid-term discounts if credits exceed threshold.

We can include a one-time 3-month pilot credit pool (up to $15k) as a promotional concession if we sign the amendment before Oct 8. For the SOC 2 question: our security team can share the redacted SOC 2 report on request; I'll include the link in a follow-up.

DocuSign link for the draft amendment: https://docusign.com/XXXXXXXXXX-amendment
Please review Option A vs. B and confirm which you prefer so we can lock pricing and generate the formal amendment.

Attaching: Gainsight_Amendment_Q3_v1.pdf (PDF, preliminary pricing)

—Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Enterprise Accounts — Gainsight
alyssa@gainsight.com
[attachment: Gainsight_Amendment_Q3_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 15:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Gainsight renewal: billing model & usage credits

Vanessa / Laura —

Quick internal notes after skimming Alyssa's draft:
- Security: we need the SOC2 report and a clear statement about data export/deletion timelines. Request that Alyssa's team confirm retention windows for analytics and any third‑party processors.
- Identity: confirm SSO and SCIM provisioning compatibility (we want zero-impact seat churn automation).
- Commercials: the pilot credit is nice; procurement will need to see the amended line items and an example PO.

I've opened SUP-3421 for procurement to own the PO issuance and vendor onboarding checklist: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SUP-3421
Laura — can you put legal on standby once we have the formal amendment? I want a quick redline cycle (48–72 hrs).

–Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@gainsight.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Gainsight CSM <csm@gainsight.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Gainsight renewal: billing model & usage credits

Vanessa / team —

Appreciate the quick review, Marcus. Per your asks: 
- SOC 2: here is a redacted copy of our Type II report for 2026/2027: [attachment: SOC2_report_redacted.pdf]. Our security team confirms that Gainsight retains analytics event data for up to 18 months by default; we can scope shorter retention for enterprise contracts.
- Identity: full SSO + SCIM support — we can provide a scoping doc and a provisioning playbook.
- Pilot credits: we can commit to the $15k pilot credit if the amendment is signed by Oct 8 and PO is submitted.

Next steps I propose:
1) Your legal/procurement reviews the attached amendment PDF and sends redlines (I'll prioritize the review with our legal).
2) If redlines are minor, we proceed to DocuSign and issuance of PO.
3) Gainsight CSM will schedule a technical kickoff within 5 business days of signature.

Let me know if you want me to loop in our Security contact directly for a call next week.

—Alyssa
[attachment: SOC2_report_redacted.pdf (PDF)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@gainsight.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 17:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Gainsight renewal: billing model & usage credits

Thanks, Alyssa — and thanks Marcus/Laura for the quick internal check. Quick recap and owners so we have a clear mutual action plan: 

Action items (Redwood):
- Legal (Laura) to ingest Gainsight_Amendment_Q3_v1.pdf and send redlines by Wed, Sep 22.
- Procurement to prepare PO (Marcus) and share draft PO with Gainsight (target Sep 24).
- Ops to confirm SCIM/SSO scoping calendar with Gainsight CSM (Vanessa) — request kickoff week of Sep 27.

Action items (Gainsight):
- Revise amendment to final PDF that includes $15k pilot credit and per‑credit rates for Option A/B and submit via DocuSign.
- Share SOC2 redacted report (received) and provisioning playbook.

Timing: we need signed amendment and PO on file by Oct 8 to ensure continuous service through the Oct 15 renewal date. If legal has material redlines beyond boilerplate, flag immediately and we'll request a 1-week extension from Procurement.

For tracking: HubSpot deal HS-4512 and Jira SUP-3421 (procurement ticket).

Attaching a draft PO template for your reference.
[attachment: Redwood_PO_draft.pdf (DOCX)]

If you can target the updated DocuSign by end of day Sep 21, procurement will run the PO and legal review in parallel. Appreciate the flexibility on the blended model — should help both sides match costs to usage.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
